integrity: All-dimensional argument is mathematical; independent finite tests are consistency checks, not an infinite proof. Authorship or independent external certification is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem is for the ternary unit-distance Hamming graph, one vertex below maximum, and labelled vertex subsets. Classical maximum size and the affinity of order-three quasigroups are prerequisites, not novel claims; possible older equivalent coordinate-line blocking-set results remain a priority risk.
title: Defect-one triangle-free stability in ternary Hamming graphs
